## cmk:adr

model-invoked · core · v1.0.0

Use when the user asks to "record this decision", "we decided to use X over Y", "document why we chose this approach", "record an ADR", "update ADR-0003", "this ADR is obsolete", "prune / archive / clean docs/decisions", or another skill reaches a decision that may need one — produces an architecture decision record in docs/decisions/ that passes the three-part gate, or a keep/archive/drop classification of the existing records.

## cmk:amend

model-invoked · core · v1.0.2

- **Where:** `skills/amend/SKILL.md`
- **Cites:** `cmk:debug`, `cmk:evidence`, `cmk:realign`, `cmk:requirements`, `cmk:scope`, `cmk:tdd`, `cmk:traceability`

## cmk:explain

model-invoked · core · v1.0.1

Use when someone wants to understand how a feature, component, module, flow, endpoint, job, or change works — or a library, protocol, or concept they need for it — "explain X", "how does X work", "walk me through X", "what happens when", "I'm new to this repo", onboarding, "what does this diff / PR / branch do", "teach me", "quiz me" — produces a code-grounded explainer — a short plain-language answer and, when the subject spans several files, one local HTML page with a runtime-path diagram, a step-through of one example, the surprises, and self-check questions. Not for why a design was chosen (cmk:research) or for picking between options (cmk:interpret).

- **Where:** `skills/explain/SKILL.md`
- **Cites:** `cmk:interpret`, `cmk:research`, `cmk:visualize`
- **Evidence:** `TESTS.md`, `eval.json`

## cmk:feature-graph

model-invoked · core · v1.4.0

## cmk:traceability

model-invoked · core · v1.3.2

Use when checking that requirement IDs agree where they are defined and task-cited in docs/specs, or that the capability catalog INDEX / shards stay intact — the docs-only vertical pass invoked by cmk:evidence, cmk:release, cmk:realign, and cmk:delivery-spec-plan. Produces a traceability finding set (unknown citations, duplicate definitions, approved-but-uncited, Respects / system-ID integrity, duplicate Feature CODEs, OBS-<6hex> in Code cells, missing shard refs). Does not search application source or tests for requirement IDs.

- **Where:** `skills/traceability/SKILL.md`
- **References:** `references/catalog-passes.md`, `references/decision-record-pass.md`, `references/invariant-passes.md`, `references/system-id-passes.md`

## cmk:visualize

model-invoked · core · v1.1.5

Use before the first line of markup for any HTML a human will look at — a dogfood test guide, a report, a dashboard, a landing page, a published artifact, a standalone .html handoff. Also when a primary figure, structure sketch, architecture diagram, sequence, or flowchart must be drawn inside that page or packet. Produces a written design plan (palette, type pairing, layout concept) and a page derived from it — and when a figure is warranted, a named figure job plus inline SVG from the diagram recipe — theme-aware, self-contained, specific to its subject instead of templated. Also when a page's colors, typography, dark mode, spacing, or visual treatment need deciding, or when a page has come out looking generic.

- **Where:** `skills/visualize/SKILL.md`
- **References:** `references/diagram.md`
- **Cites:** `cmk:architecture-scan`, `cmk:explain`
- **Evidence:** `TESTS.md`, `eval.json`
